soc.description: **ARK Sentinel** is our always-on SOC bot. It tails application logs, WAF alerts, cloud posture scans and on-chain watchers, and logs a security event the moment something looks wrong. High-severity events with a `promote` flag are turned into findings automatically, so nothing slips through overnight. Events arrive here via `POST /api/ingest`.
